names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 26 Ιουλίου, «Άγιοι Ερμόλαος, Έρμιππος και Ερμοκράτης», with the rank word left off; his own head line on the shared page is «Αγιος Ερμιππος (; - 305)».

death.note: saint.gr heads him «Αγιος Ερμιππος (; - 305)», and gives the same year to each of the three priests on the page. It gives no year of birth.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (1 October 2026).

Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (1 October 2026). The corpus's `hermolaus-of-nicomedia` carries a Romanian row for 26 iulie off doxologia's «Sfântul Sfințit Mucenic Ermolae», and whether that calendar also prints his two companions is a reading nobody has done.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 26ης Ιουλίου — «Άγιοι Ερμόλαος, Έρμιππος και Ερμοκράτης»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 26 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and carries the three priests on one page with a head line each — the enumeration is why this is three folders and not one, of which the corpus already holds Hermolaus. He is not `hermippus-companion-of-emilian`, the only other man of the name in the corpus, whom the Russian calendar keeps on the Julian 18 August with the hieromartyr Emilian of Cyzicus; that is another company, another day and another year. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence. The page prints two apolytikia and both are taken: a proper that names all three by name, and the common of martyrs «Οἱ Μάρτυρές σου Κύριε» printed under their names as «Έτερον Ἀπολυτίκιον». Nicomedia is named and `locations` is left out, since the page places him there by his clergy and his trial and gives no life otherwise.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (1 October 2026).

hymns.text: Ἱερατεύσαντες, γνησίως Ἅγιοι, τῷ πρυτανεύσαντι, ἡμῖν τὰ κρείττονα, τοῦ μαρτυρίου τὴν ὁδόν, ἠνύσατε γηθοσύνως, Ἱερὲ Ἑρμόλαε, σὺν Ἑρμίππω Ἑρμόκρατες, τρίστυλον ἑδραίωμα, Ἐκκλησίας γενόμενοι, διὸ ἐκδυσωπεῖτε ἀπαύστως, σώζεσθαι πάντας πάσης βλάβης.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον (Κατέβασμα), Ἦχος γ’, Τὴν ὡραιότητα — on the shared page of «Άγιοι Ερμόλαος, Έρμιππος και Ερμοκράτης». It names all three, so it is the proper of the three and no mis-hang

english.text: Having served as true priests to him who bestows better things upon us, O holy ones, you accomplished the road of martyrdom with gladness, sacred Hermolaus, with Hermippus and Hermocrates, and became a three-pillared foundation of the Church. Therefore entreat him unceasingly, that all may be kept safe from every harm.

hymns.text: Οἱ Μάρτυρές σου Κύριε, ἐν τῇ ἀθλήσει αὐτῶν, τὸ στέφος ἐκομίσαντο τῆς ἀφθαρσίας, ἐκ σοῦ τοῦ Θεοῦ ἡμῶν· σχόντες γὰρ τὴν ἰσχύν σου, τοὺς τυράννους καθεῖλον· ἔθραυσαν καὶ δαιμόνων τὰ ἀνίσχυρα θράση. Αὐτῶν ταῖς ἱκεσίαις Χριστὲ ὁ Θεός, σῶσον τὰς ψυχὰς ἡμῶν.

source.text: saint.gr, Έτερον Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος δ’, Ταχύ προκατάλαβε — the second hymn on the shared page of «Άγιοι Ερμόλαος, Έρμιππος και Ερμοκράτης». It is the common of martyrs and names nobody, but the page prints it under their names, so by the corpus's rule it is their service and is copied whole

english.text: Your martyrs, O Lord, received from you our God the crown of incorruption in their contest; for having your strength they cast down the tyrants, and they broke the powerless insolence of the demons as well. By their supplications, O Christ God, save our souls.
